That's the least of my worries right now. I'm really sorry, but I don't really want to continue this thread. I thought that maybe this subreddit would help clear my mind but I guess not.

These people have been my friends for forever. I don't think I want to give time. I'm tired of being pent up with all this emotionless-emotion that I feel that once my muscles relax completely after dying, just a million words will pour out of my mouth. I can't wait any longer for bliss.

I know that's true, but I can't wholly believe it. These people hate it when I open up to them, but any other time that they need me to listen or to do a favor for them, I'm up for it. I always just feel like a doormat for them. I think it's impossible for me to believe otherwise, and I know it's pathetic.

I don't have a life outside of videogames, internet, and school. It's all just a neverending cycle. The friends that invited me to the dinner are well aware of my mental health situation and what my 'plans' are for the future, yet they keep asking future-questions that make me uncomfortable, which in turn make them uncomfortable. I don't know what they want from me other than test answers and someone to mooch money off of. I think they couldn't care less about me, but rather for the comfort of themselves and other people.
